audit.summary: The printed loss normalizer and concentration direction conflict with the stated cross-view objective. The frozen release has recipe differences in concentration, temperature and projection training. Optimizer batch and contrastive pool size require separate specification, but the documentation permits the ordinary optimizer-batch interpretation; no batch-semantics error or historical benchmark effect is established. Algorithm 1 supplies a coherent loss.
limitations: Limitations: No author code executed or benchmark reproduced.
Limitations: Current frozen release does not establish the historical experimental implementation.
Limitations: No validation of original timing measurements, stochastic variation or complete downstream pipelines.
Limitations: Formula repair does not choose the historical configuration or certify a revised training system.
P1 — Counterevidence: A global-index all-view interpretation is possible only with changed notation/objective; it does not equal Algorithm 1.

P1 — Counterevidence and alternatives: Global2B indexing could exclude anchor-self correctly but adds same-branch negatives and changes the notation and algorithm. The algorithm and frozen forward_loss are coherent and agree, so no historical training failure follows.
P2 — Counterevidence: p.7 increasing-kappa explanation supports the correct direction; identity-based positives do not change.

P2 — Counterevidence and alternatives: The p.7 increasing-kappa harder-task statement points in the correct direction; positive labels are paired by image identity. A half-height criterion is an explicit geometric diagnostic, not a proof of semantic value.
P3 — Counterevidence: Fixed reciprocal temperature can encode a value of tau but not training; later or historical unprovided configurations may differ.

P3 — Counterevidence and alternatives: Fixed reciprocal temperature represents one tau value but is not a trainable parameter. Ordinary dependency trainability is explicit rather than claimed as an executed gradient check. A historical different implementation/configuration remains possible; static release discrepancy does not show benchmark errors. The main-text2048 reference is distinct from the source parser default1800.

P4 — Counterevidence: Effective batch conventionally counts images per optimizer update, which accumulation preserves. At fixed accumulation and device count, increasing local microbatch increases both effective batch and local negatives, compatible with the paper explanation.

P4 — Counterevidence and alternatives: The documentation promises optimizer effective batch, a convention satisfied by accumulation, and does not promise the same negative pool. Table3 can vary local microbatch at fixed device and accumulation counts, expanding both sizes; its negative-pool explanation is therefore compatible with the code.
Scope limit: Inspection and independent diagnostics are not an empirical reproduction or exhaustive correctness certification.
The original report's complete scope, counterevidence and unresolved questions are retained below.
This import checks publication format and identity; it does not repeat scientific review.
Independent human scientific review is pending; author adoption has not been requested.
